title: Accessibility and colimit closure of a compact filtered hull
statement: Use universes, accessibility, compactness, coherent functors and colimits from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa$ be an infinite regular cardinal in the smaller universe. Let $\mathcal E$ be a presentable infinity category, and let $\mathcal E_0\subseteq\mathcal E$ be an essentially small full subcategory that is replete (closed under equivalence), of $\kappa$-compact objects, closed under $\kappa$-small colimits computed in $\mathcal E$. Let $\mathcal E_1$ be the replete full subcategory consisting of objects equivalent to colimits of small $\kappa$-filtered diagrams taking values in $\mathcal E_0$. Then $\mathcal E_1$ is $\kappa$-accessible, admits all small colimits, and is closed under all small colimits computed in $\mathcal E$; its inclusion preserves these colimits. Every object of $\mathcal E_1$ has such a presentation indexed by the nerve of a small $\kappa$-filtered partially ordered set. Every object of $\mathcal E_0$ belongs to $\mathcal E_1$.
